more_info.overview: Butane is a hydrocarbon gas, specified as the straight-chain isomer for this additive entry. It supplies pressure used to expel food from a container. The specified material is supplied as colourless liquid or gas. EU permissions include vegetable oil pan spray.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain vegetable oil pan spray.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
